SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
I. REGISTRY
No. D. 99 H.S/3
Date 15 4 1940

April 14, 1940.

MAINICHI :-

ASSASSINATION OF S.M.P. OFFICER.

Mr. Tan Shao Liang, 52, a member of the Section 2, Special Branch of the Shanghai Municipal Police, was attacked by a gang of four desperadoes in the vicinity of the junction of Seymour and Wei-Hai-Wei Roads shortly after 9 a.m. April 13, when he was proceeding to his office from his home. The desperadoes almost simultaneously fired at the officer from behind and the victim died on the spot from several bullets which penetrated his body. The attack immediately drew the attention of officers from Bubbling Well Police Station, who were on duty in the vicinity of the scene of the incident, These officers immediately gave chase to the desperadoes, who fled in the direction of the French Concession. In the French Concession, fierce gun fire was exchanged between the four assassins and the police officers, as a result of which a Chinese constable No.2556 received a bullet in his abdomen, while one of the assassins was shot and killed on the spot and two of them were arrested. One assassin successfully managed to escape and is now sought by the Municipal Police.

Mr. Tan, the victim, formerly acted as liaison officer between the Municipal Police and the former Shanghai City Government of the Chungking regime and transmitted information regarding local Japanese to the Chungking Regime.

Mr. Tan recently intended to approach the new regime to cope with the new situation; this was noticed by the Chungking Regime and it is probable that he was assassinated for treachery.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
一、登记处
编号 D. 99 H.S/3
日期 1940年4月15日

1940年4月14日。

《每日新闻》：

工部局警务处警官遇刺案。

谭绍良（音译）先生，52岁，系上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科第二股成员，于4月13日上午9时过后不久，在从住所前往办公室途中，行至西摩路与威海卫路交界处附近时，遭到四名暴徒袭击。暴徒从背后几乎同时向该警官开枪，受害者身中数弹，当场死亡。此次袭击立即引起了当时在事发地附近执勤的静安寺捕房警员的注意。这些警员立即追赶向法租界方向逃窜的暴徒。在法租界内，四名刺客与警员之间发生了激烈的枪战，结果导致一名华捕（编号2556）腹部中弹，其中一名刺客当场被击毙，两名刺客被捕。另一名刺客成功逃脱，目前正由工部局警务处通缉。

受害者谭先生此前曾担任工部局警务处与重庆政权前上海市政府之间的联络官，并向重庆政权传递有关当地日本人的情报。

谭先生最近打算接触新政权以应对新形势；此举被重庆政权察觉，他很可能因背叛而被暗杀。

April 14, 1940. Morning Translation.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO :-

Motive for the assassination of Supt. Tan.

In connection with the assassination
of Superintendent Tan of the Municipal Police, the
headquarters of the Municipal Police have been conducting
thorough investigation in cooperation with the French
Police, but the motive of the crime is at present unknown.
In some sources, it is stated that the assassination was
carried out at the direction of the Chungking Regime, but
the authorities concerned have adopted a cautious attitude.
It appears that investigation will be started after the
recovery of the offender who is now detained in the
French Police Hospital.

1940年4月14日。晨间译文。

《大陆新报》：

谭督察遇刺动机。

关于工部局警务处谭督察遇刺一事，工部局警务处总部正与法国警察合作进行彻底调查，但目前犯罪动机尚不清楚。有消息来源称，此次暗杀是受重庆政权指使所为，但有关当局持谨慎态度。看来，待目前羁押于法国警察医院的那名罪犯康复后，将开始展开调查。
